tools.name: search_tickers
tools.description: Find US stock and ETF tickers on file by symbol or company name, listed or delisted. Returns each match with the first and last date it has data for under its name. A symbol that other companies used before says how many earlier periods it has.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: What is on file for one ticker: its name, the first and last date with data under that name, how many trades, and what its data costs. A symbol that was used before also lists its earlier periods, each with the name on record at the time.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Everything that can be bought, with prices in US dollars: tick data for single tickers, bars and tick data for the S&P 500 or every ticker, and the optional daily update plan.

tools.name: get_file_format
tools.description: How the files are laid out: the columns of each dataset, their types, timestamps, trading hours, timeframes, and code that loads a file with pandas.

tools.name: get_sample_files
tools.description: Free files to download and try, with no sign-up: one stock for one trading day as 1-minute bars, trades and quotes, and its daily bars. Returns each file's address, rows, size and columns.

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.description: For a buyer: what they have bought. Needs the buyer's API token in the Authorization header.

tools.name: list_purchase_files
tools.description: For a buyer: the files of one purchase, each with its size, checksum and download address. Download an address with the same Authorization header. Needs the buyer's API token.
